title: When you spot SSV at +38% and your brain says 'Buy the dip', but your wallet screams 'Leverage!'
content:
👀 3 AM: “Just checking the chart” → 5 min later I'm watching SSV moon like a Netflix binge. Meanwhile Bitcoin’s chill at $60.8k like it’s on a coffee break.
💸 My leverage ratio is now a relationship status: ‘It’s complicated.’
lesson: Never let a 38% mover convince you to upgrade from “just watching” to “all‑in” without a stop‑loss.
question: Who else turned a casual SSV glance into a full‑blown lever‑fest? Drop your most reckless 1‑minute chart stare story 👇
